commit.message:
fix(b4-integrity): current-observation freshness precedes any positive present-tense verdict

monitor_resurrection() evaluated RESURRECTED_NOT_ABSENT (served HTTP 200 +
marker) and REDEPLOYMENT_MECHANISM_ACTIVE (observed CI mechanism) before
rejecting an expired or otherwise invalid current observation, so a
historical current observation older than the contractual 900s TTL could be
promoted into a new present-tense finding. One narrow source-and-test repair
within the existing B4 work (WORK-B4-28, no new work item):

- current_freshness.is_valid_for_evaluation now gates both positive
  present-tense verdicts; stale marker/mechanism sightings are retained as
  historical evidence / recorded redevelopment risk only
  (STALE_REAPPEARANCE_EVIDENCE_RETAINED / STALE_MECHANISM_EVIDENCE_RETAINED)
- expired, future-skewed, missing and malformed current timestamps fail
  closed to STALE_REVALIDATION_REQUIRED
- fresh genuine exact-URL-bound reappearance still awards
  RESURRECTED_NOT_ABSENT even with an old historical absence record
  (historical authenticity and current freshness are separate requirements)
- no weaker-evidence award of CONTINUED_ABSENCE_OBSERVED / OBSERVED_ABSENT /
  SAFE_TO_RETIRE / RESURRECTION_CONTROLLED; immutable receipts, ledger
  validation, target/URL/SHA binding and protected-target refusals intact
- 10 new adversarial production-path tests in
  tests/test_b4_resurrection_monitoring.py; suite 540 passed; ruff clean;
  40/40 network-free safety assertions
- live evidence regenerated read-only (resurrection_monitoring.json, 12
  invariants, unchanged honest HISTORICAL_RECEIPT_UNVERIFIED verdict);
  control_room/data.js rebuilt (sha256 00bd24c0...)
- README / Evidence Matrix / Master Execution Plan / HANDOFF updated in the
  same change; no live resurrection or unpublish occurred or is claimed
commit.title: fix(b4-integrity): current-observation freshness precedes any positive present-tense verdict
